question: Large tidal waves caused by an underwater earthquake or volcanic eruption are known as a ________.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**tsunami**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **tsunami** is a series of large tidal waves caused by the displacement of a significant amount of water, often due to underwater events such as **earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, or landslides.**
 
• These waves can travel across the ocean at speeds of up to **800 kilometers per hour** and cause severe destruction upon reaching coastal areas.
 
• The term "tsunami" originates from the Japanese words "**tsu**" (harbor) and "nami</strong&
